system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Acrobatics and Thievery, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Burglary Lore, Urban Architecture Lore, Household Security Lore.
system.description: You entered buildings by routes their owners had never intended as entrances. You learned to cross awkward spaces quietly and open a lock before anyone thought to check the door.
